title: Exterior derivative along a slice: dω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv) = (Dω(ι(t, x))e₀)(Jv) − d(η_t)(x)(v)
statement: Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1), Jv := ι(0, v), d := exteriorDerivative (Mathlib extDeriv), Dω := fderiv ℝ ω and 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) := TestFormOn univ k. (a) For all N, k ∈ ℕ, every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) and every family η : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all t, x, v, one has, for all t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N and v = (v_1, …, v_{k+1}) ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}: dω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_{k+1}) = (Dω(ι(t, x))e₀)(Jv_1, …, Jv_{k+1}) − d(η_t)(x)(v_1, …, v_{k+1}). (b) For all N ∈ ℕ, every ω ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}), t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N and the empty tuple v : Fin 0 → ℝ^N: dω(ι(t, x))(e₀) = (Dω(ι(t, x))e₀)() (in Lean the arguments are Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v) and J ∘ v).
lean_statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1)) (η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))) - exteriorDerivative (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v) ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) 0) (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin 0 → Euclid N), exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) 0) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))
